ImageDescription.value: Sarajevo Trg Oslobođenja 1943-45. Za vrijeme njemačko-ustaške okupacije Bosne i Hercegovine jedan dio trga, ispred Doma armije dobio je ime po Hercegu Stjepanu Kosači dok je veći dio parka nazvan po kralju Stjepanu Tomaševiću. U to vrijeme na trgu je postojao spomenik sa nacističkim orlom koji je srušen odmah nakon oslobođenja grada.

ImageDescription.value: Serbian male and female elementary school, then a seminary; during the Second World War, NDH police and prison; after the war the Technical Faculty. Today, with the extended front facing the park, it houses the Faculty of Economics (Liberation Square ). In the lower right, you can see the sculpture of a Girl with a Book, which today is located in front of the building of the Faculty of Architecture and Civil Engineering
